name: Bonko
summary:
Bonko VR is your ultimate playground for chaos, competition, and pure fun with friends.
Jump into a wild VR world packed with unpredictable PvP action, hilarious mini-games, and social spaces designed for goofing around or just hanging out. Whether you're launching into ridiculous battles, pulling off absurd stunts, or vibing in a chill environment, Bonko VR keeps the energy high and the laughs coming.

Fight, prank, explore, or relax it’s your world, your rules.
Bonko VR blends over-the-top multiplayer mad
